snippet.title: RitualRX - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
⛤--------------------------------------------------------------⛤

DO WHATEVER IT TAKES,
LEAVE NOTHING BEHIND.

KILL FAST,
OR DIE FASTER.

⛤--------------------------------------------------------------⛤

Get your prescription today and play the demo for RitualRX on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3600980/RitualRX_Demo

Interested in learning more about the game? Join the Discord server:
https://discord.gg/SE6nwVZxsE

Features 'Rebels' & 'DEAD FOR NOW' by @Rudolve  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mvAIiX6O3GE&list=OLAK5uy_lrH8mu-Y1P1RSFx7G9DnWoqMxv552km40
https://rudolve.bandcamp.com/

⛤--------------------------------------------------------------⛤

RitualRX is a brutally violent, blisteringly fast, adrenaline-pumping shooter set within a pastel paradise ruled by cults. Control a group of excommunicated sinners as you shoot, slash, and slaughter your way through a city where ritual is prescribed and the only treatment administered is an overdose of lead.
